changes.title: Workspace cleanup becomes review-bound and recoverable
changes.summary: Agent Plugins 0.3.2 refreshes Workspace Hygiene so agents apply cleanup only to exact reviewed ids and safely reconcile interrupted provisioning, durable removals, missing records, and legacy trees.

changes.title: Repository datasets become typed documentation inputs

relations.label: Supplies passive structured data to unified documentation views

changes.title: Documentation becomes one safely collected public system

relations.label: Supplies the safe publication and compatibility contracts

changes.title: Passive Docusaurus markers enter the locked documentation corpus
changes.summary: Docs System 0.3.3 admits inert whole-line MDX comments and explicit heading ids without allowing executable expressions or changing collected bytes.

relations.label: Collects source-owned field notes, generated status markers, and stable heading ids without executing MDX

changes.title: Website collection receives a Node-safe manifest entry point

relations.label: Keeps Website source collection independent of Docusaurus theme aliases

changes.title: Connectors joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Connectors now exposes its catalog, architecture, adoption guides, dependencies, and current maturity through the shared b10x documentation contract.

relations.label: Supplies governed operations to Agent Platform

changes.title: Eventlog joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Eventlog now publishes its library boundary, crate layout, adoption path, and downstream role through the shared b10x documentation contract.

relations.label: Supplies durable workflow state and evidence

changes.title: Identity joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Identity now advertises its service boundary, local adoption path, API reference, dependencies, and deployment maturity through the shared b10x documentation contract.

changes.title: Agent interaction research joins public discovery

changes.title: Workflow joins the public ecosystem surface
